articles.title: Wrong Doorbell Triggers Violent Clash: Guards vs Delivery Executives at Noida Housing Society
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chaos erupted at the main gate of Nimbus Society in the Beta-2 police station area on Saturday after a minor dispute between a security guard and a delivery executive escalated into a violent scuffle.

body.html:
Chaos erupted at the main gate of Nimbus Society in the Beta-2 police station area on Saturday after a minor dispute between a security guard and a delivery executive escalated into a violent scuffle.

According to reports, the incident began when a delivery executive rang the doorbell of the wrong flat. The flat owner allegedly argued with him and later informed the society’s security guards. The verbal exchange soon intensified, following which the delivery executive reportedly called his companions.

Within minutes, the situation spiralled out of control, with both sides allegedly resorting to physical violence. Fists, kicks, sticks and batons were reportedly used as the clash unfolded near the society gate.

Several residents recorded the incident on their mobile phones. The videos, which have since gone viral on social media, show both groups attacking each other, raising serious concerns about safety and security inside the residential complex.

On receiving information, Beta-2 police rushed to the spot and brought the situation under control. Police have started questioning those involved and are analysing the viral video footage as part of the investigation.

Kotwali in-charge Vinod Kumar said the matter is being thoroughly probed and assured that appropriate legal action will be taken based on the findings.

articles.title: ‘18 Hours of Work, ₹10,000 Salary’: Imran Masood Raises Vande Bharat Staff Exploitation Issue
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Congress MP from Saharanpur, Imran Masood, has raised serious concerns over alleged exploitation of private staff working on the Vande Bharat Express, flagging the issue of railway privatisation and employee harassment.

body.html:
Congress MP from Saharanpur, Imran Masood, has raised serious concerns over alleged exploitation of private staff working on the Vande Bharat Express, flagging the issue of railway privatisation and employee harassment.

While travelling on the Vande Bharat train, Masood interacted with cleaning and catering staff and listened to their grievances. According to him, private contractors are allegedly forcing workers to put in up to 18 hours of work daily while paying them only ₹10,000 per month, which is below the minimum wage.

Masood said the staff are being treated “like machines” and are left with barely three hours of sleep. He pointed out that while sleeper trains at least provide limited space to rest, Vande Bharat trains do not offer any resting space for staff.

Taking immediate action, the Congress MP asked his team to document the complaints and prepare a letter to the Railway Minister. He said the matter would be raised in the Lok Sabha under Rule 377, which allows MPs to highlight public interest issues directly before the ministry.

“Privatisation within the Railways is leading to severe harassment. The Railways is paying contractors, contractors are profiting, and poor workers are suffering,” Masood said.

He also directed that a separate question be prepared for the Lok Sabha and stated that if Vande Bharat services are managed properly, travel time on certain routes could be reduced by up to two hours. Masood has sought an appointment with the Railway Minister on February 28 to discuss the issue.

A video of the MP’s interaction with Vande Bharat staff has surfaced on social media, drawing attention to working conditions on premium trains.

#ImranMasood #VandeBharat #RailwayPrivatisation #LabourRights #MinimumWage #IndianRailways #Parliament #BreakingNews

articles.title: Fear Inside Pizza Shop: Young Couple Jumps From Second Floor After Alleged Harassment
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young man and a woman sustained serious injuries after they jumped from the second floor of a pizza restaurant in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, allegedly out of fear when members of a Hindu organisation confronted them.

body.html:
A young man and a woman sustained serious injuries after they jumped from the second floor of a pizza restaurant in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, allegedly out of fear when members of a Hindu organisation confronted them.

The incident took place on Saturday evening at Pizza 99 restaurant in Akarkara Rasulpur area under the Kant police station limits, near Bareilly Morh. The couple, aged 21 and 19, was sitting together at the restaurant when several individuals arrived and allegedly questioned them, asked for identity cards and inquired about their caste.

According to police sources, the couple told the group they were Hindus. It is alleged that some people then began filming them, which caused panic. In fear, the young man reportedly pulled out a window bar and jumped from the second floor. The woman also jumped soon after. Both were seriously injured and admitted to a private hospital.

The youth, Vishal, later alleged that the filming and questioning frightened them, forcing the couple to take the extreme step. Based on his complaint, police have registered an FIR against Pravesh, Sonu, Harshit and four to five unidentified persons.

Shahjahanpur SP Rajesh Dwivedi said police reached the spot immediately and are investigating the matter. He added that strict action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

articles.title: Ambulance Turns Killer on Prayagraj–Rewa Highway: Two Teen Friends Crushed to Death in Ghurpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident on the Prayagraj–Rewa highway claimed the lives of two teenage boys on Saturday afternoon in Kanti village under the Ghurpur police station area.

body.html:
A tragic road accident on the Prayagraj–Rewa highway claimed the lives of two teenage boys on Saturday afternoon in Kanti village under the Ghurpur police station area.

The victims, identified as Rinku (15) and Shobhit (12), were riding bicycles to a government ration shop when a speeding government ambulance hit them from behind. Both boys died on the spot. Shockingly, one of the teenagers got trapped under the ambulance and was dragged for nearly 40 metres.

Following the incident, angry locals chased the ambulance driver, caught him while he was trying to flee, assaulted him and later handed him over to the Ghurpur police. The accident led to a traffic jam on the Prayagraj–Rewa highway for nearly an hour.

Rinku, a Class 9 student, was the second among two brothers and two sisters, while Shobhit, a Class 6 student, was the eldest of two brothers and two sisters. Residents said the two boys shared a close friendship and were standing by the roadside when the ambulance, coming from Jari towards Prayagraj at high speed, struck them.

Police reached the spot after receiving information and took the driver into custody. Further investigation into the incident is underway.

articles.title: MBBS Admission Obsession: Jaunpur Youth Amputates Own Leg to Claim Disabled Quota, Police Expose
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Jaunpur district of Uttar Pradesh, a 24-year-old man allegedly amputated his own leg in an attempt to secure admission to an MBBS course under the disabled quota.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Jaunpur district of Uttar Pradesh, a 24-year-old man allegedly amputated his own leg in an attempt to secure admission to an MBBS course under the disabled quota. Police investigations later revealed that the injury was self-inflicted and not the result of any external attack, as initially claimed.

The incident occurred in the Line Bazaar police station area. The youth, identified as Suraj Bhaskar, a resident of Khalilpur, was found injured on the morning of January 19 at his under-construction house. He had severed four fingers of his left foot, leaving only the thumb intact. He was first admitted to the district hospital and later shifted to a private hospital, where he is currently undergoing treatment.

Suraj, who holds a D-Pharma degree and had been preparing for MBBS for the past three years, initially told police that two unidentified men attacked him at night, rendering him unconscious and amputating his foot. Based on his statement, police registered a case of attempted murder and launched an investigation.

However, during the probe, police recovered syringes, anaesthesia vials and a cutting machine from near the spot. Call Detail Records (CDR), diary entries and interrogation of family members revealed that Suraj was under severe mental stress due to repeated failure in securing MBBS admission. A diary recovered from him mentioned his determination to get admission in 2026 “at any cost”. Police also found that he had discussed the plan with his girlfriend.

City Superintendent of Police Goldy Gupta said the investigation confirmed that no outsiders were involved. “Suraj used his medical knowledge to carry out the act himself, hoping to benefit from the disabled quota,” she said, adding that he is now stable and further investigation is underway.

Police officials noted that the case highlights the extreme mental pressure faced by aspirants and the dangerous paths some may take under stress.

articles.title: ‘Miracle or Mystery?’ Neem Tree Emits Sparks Near Shiva Temple in UP, Devotees Flock in Hundreds
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Claims of divine intervention surfaced after sparks were seen emerging from a neem tree near a Shiva temple in Sarai Baroliya village under the Ughaiti police station area of Budaun district, Uttar Pradesh.

body.html:
Claims of divine intervention surfaced after sparks were seen emerging from a neem tree near a Shiva temple in Sarai Baroliya village under the Ughaiti police station area of Budaun district, Uttar Pradesh.

The incident occurred on Friday, January 23, 2026, during a Lakshmi Narayan Mahayagya at the ancient Siddh Baba Bholenath Shiva temple. According to locals, sparks began coming out from the roots of the neem tree located directly in front of the temple around 8 am. The tree reportedly continued to burn internally for nearly 18 hours, while its outer surface remained green and intact.

Villagers attempted to extinguish the fire by pouring water and covering it with soil, but the sparks continued until late at night. As news spread, large crowds from nearby villages gathered at the site, which is considered sacred due to the presence of an ancient forest area and a mysterious cave nearby.

Hundreds of devotees performed pooja and circumambulation around the tree, interpreting the incident as a divine sign associated with Lord Shiva. Women and children were also seen participating in prayers, while discussions continued over whether the incident was a miracle or a natural phenomenon.

Some locals believe the event confirms the spiritual power of the siddh site, while others suggest it may have been caused by natural or chemical factors. No scientific explanation has been confirmed so far. Officials have taken note of the incident, and the fire has now completely extinguished.

articles.title: CCTV Horror in Pune: 5-Year-Old Cycling Inside Society Crushed by Car
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A five-year-old boy was killed after being run over by a car while riding his bicycle inside a residential society in Pune. The incident occurred on Monday afternoon in the Loni Kalbhor area and was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A five-year-old boy was killed after being run over by a car while riding his bicycle inside a residential society in Pune. The incident occurred on Monday afternoon in the Loni Kalbhor area and was captured on CCTV.

The deceased was identified as Nishkarsh Ashwat Swami, a resident of Joy Nest Society. According to the police, the child was playing inside the society premises with his grandmother around 3.30 pm when a car entered the complex and hit him.

CCTV visuals show the impact of the collision, following which the car driver stepped out and rushed the injured child to a private hospital. However, doctors declared Nishkarsh dead during treatment.

Based on a complaint filed by the child’s father, Ashwat Narayan Swami, Loni Kalbhor police have registered a case against the driver. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Bride Flees Hours After Wedding With ₹2 Lakh, Mentally Challenged Groom Left Helpless | Gwalior
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A mentally challenged man was left helpless after his bride allegedly fled with her associates and ₹2 lakh just hours after their marriage in Gwalior on Friday. Police have registered a case of cheating and fraud following a complaint by the groom’s father.

body.html:
A mentally challenged man was left helpless after his bride allegedly fled with her associates and ₹2 lakh just hours after their marriage in Gwalior on Friday. Police have registered a case of cheating and fraud following a complaint by the groom’s father.

According to police, the victim’s family resides on Shivpuri Road in Gwalior. The groom’s father, Mahendra Parashar, told police that his son Ashmit Parashar is mentally challenged. In an effort to secure his future, he agreed to arrange his marriage through a man identified as Bunty Dhakad, a resident of Morena district.

Mahendra alleged that Bunty Dhakad introduced a woman named Poonam Gaur as a suitable match. The marriage was arranged through a notarised process. In return for arranging the alliance, Bunty Dhakad allegedly took ₹2 lakh from the groom’s family. Trusting him, the family paid the amount and completed the marriage formalities.

However, within hours of the wedding, the situation took a dramatic turn. Mahendra Parashar alleged that Bunty Dhakad and his associates intercepted their car on the road. During this time, the bride, Poonam Gaur, allegedly left the groom and boarded an Activa with Bunty Dhakad and his associates, identified as Rakesh Sharma and Hira Thakur, before fleeing from the spot.
The groom and his family were left stranded and shocked by the incident.

During the investigation, police found that Poonam Gaur is a resident of the Hazira police station area near Choude Hanuman in Gwalior. Her brother, Hemant, informed police that Poonam had left home nearly two years ago and had been living separately since then. He also stated that the family had no contact with her during this period.

Following the incident, Mahendra Parashar lodged a formal complaint. Late Thursday night, police registered a case against Poonam Gaur, Bunty Dhakad and their associates under sections related to cheating and fraud.

Police officials added that the groom’s family had met the accused only a day before the marriage. Efforts are underway to trace the accused, and further investigation is in progress.

body.html:
A video showing a drunk woman creating a scene at a wine shop in Andhra Pradesh’s Bapatla town has gone viral on social media. The incident occurred at Srinivasa Wines in the Railpet area a few days ago but came to light after the video surfaced online.

In the footage, the visibly intoxicated woman is seen arguing with the wine shop staff before turning aggressive. She allegedly entered the shop and assaulted the staff, creating panic at the spot. Locals and bystanders attempted to restrain her, but she continued her aggressive behaviour.

The incident left residents shocked, as such scenes are rarely witnessed in public places. The video has since spread widely across social media platforms, drawing strong reactions from netizens.
